scope: Local thirty-five-item package, separate from the preceding 34- and 45-item passes. No publication.

improvements.title: Recover unfinished arguments
improvements.implementation: Persistent bounded argument drafts store interpretation, observation, evidence, reconsideration and passage choices separately from saved backups.

improvements.title: Protect concurrent argument edits
improvements.implementation: Stored baseline comparison and safe reread prevent newer saves/deletions from being overwritten without review.

improvements.title: Guard painting changes in an argument
improvements.implementation: Painting and other-argument selection remain disabled until the active draft is saved or discarded.

improvements.title: Undo argument deletion
improvements.implementation: Idempotent bounded restoration preserves newer records with the same identity.

improvements.title: Undo passage deletion
improvements.implementation: Both study controls and the passage library support restoring removed bookmarks.

improvements.title: Review linked passage removal
improvements.implementation: Identifies saved arguments using a passage; retain dangling references or explicitly detach them. Undo reconnects only unchanged argument versions.

improvements.title: Search arguments
improvements.implementation: Queries span interpretation, visible observation, evidence and reconsideration text.

improvements.title: Filter arguments by artwork
improvements.implementation: An artwork selector narrows the saved argument library without changing records.

improvements.title: Return focus after saving
improvements.implementation: A saved/revised entry is revealed and focused; active list filters reset so the entry is present.

improvements.title: Multiple supporting passages
improvements.implementation: Up to five distinct passages; the legacy primary-passage field remains supported.

improvements.title: Comparison draft recovery
improvements.implementation: A separate validated comparison recovery store survives refresh and navigation.

improvements.title: Comparison conflict review
improvements.implementation: A newer saved note cannot be overwritten until the reader accepts a baseline or returns to the latest copy.

improvements.title: Comparison library
improvements.implementation: My Art lists saved pairs and links to their exact comparison URL.

improvements.title: Comparison export and print
improvements.implementation: Exports complete private text and both artworks’ references without images; print isolation restores screen disclosure state.

improvements.title: Edit detail-note text
improvements.implementation: Revisions preserve the existing note ID and retain other annotations.

improvements.title: Detail draft recovery
improvements.implementation: Text, coordinates, side and edited-record baseline survive an interrupted visit.

improvements.title: Reposition a saved detail
improvements.implementation: Existing coordinate controls revise the selected note without recreating it.

improvements.title: Explicit annotation sides
improvements.implementation: New notes distinguish front, back and paired source photograph. Original coordinates remain unchanged; a missing reverse is never replaced with a front image.

improvements.title: Bulk collection additions
improvements.implementation: Select multiple saved works and preview destination memberships before applying.

improvements.title: Copy or move reviewed memberships
improvements.implementation: Reports existing/new memberships; applies against a checked collection snapshot. Saved paintings and writing remain intact.

improvements.title: Undo collection-member removal
improvements.implementation: Restores original placement where possible without duplicates or removal of newer memberships.

improvements.title: Unique renamed collections
improvements.implementation: Creation and rename use normalized name comparison with an explicit retry after validation errors.

improvements.title: Find personal collections
improvements.implementation: Searches personal collection names without modifying stored names or membership.

improvements.title: Compare collection overlap
improvements.implementation: Shows shared works and works unique to each chosen collection.

improvements.title: Deliberate exhibition restart
improvements.implementation: A confirmation panel restarts only the walkthrough; sequence, introduction and notes stay intact.

improvements.title: Paragraph bookmarks
improvements.implementation: Existing passage tool can save a specific numbered paragraph with a stable exact anchor.

improvements.title: Identify shortened excerpts
improvements.implementation: New bookmarks record truncation and link to full context. Older bookmarks are not falsely claimed to be complete or unchanged.

improvements.title: Compare changed editorial passages
improvements.implementation: Public work/paragraph IDs retrieve only current public text signatures and excerpts. Saved excerpts remain untouched when text differs.

improvements.title: Accurate accented highlights
improvements.implementation: Normalized matching maps to original string offsets, including distant accented words and punctuation.

improvements.title: Specific notebook empty states
improvements.implementation: Distinguishes no saved writing, no matching query, collection selection and writing-type absence.

improvements.title: Specific backup validation errors
improvements.implementation: Identifies record type/index and limits without revealing submitted private text or changing the file.

improvements.title: Identify backup scope
improvements.implementation: Preview distinguishes original gallery-only files from complete Art Room backups.

improvements.title: Show capacity near actions
improvements.implementation: Passage, argument, collection, comparison and per-artwork detail-note limits appear beside relevant tools; safe retries reread current copies.

improvements.title: Cross-browser coverage
improvements.implementation: Tracked Chromium/WebKit/Firefox projects. Chromium and WebKit launch and execute checks; Firefox remains blocked by its local profile-folder startup error.

improvements.title: Writing browser-history journeys
improvements.implementation: Back, Forward, refresh and canceled in-app navigation across eight editor cases, plus an actual institutional new-tab handoff with a locally stubbed destination.

browser.firefox: pending: local runtime profile-folder launch failure

verification.visualReview: desktop and phone emulation, including conflict, membership preview, verso annotation and comparison print states
